# MF14 independent inputs

The exact input plan `2c7315698b92127458110bab7308d8a5c7497bff35ea0b00e4d078f8954ad515` was fixed as the generator and auditor adoption constant before one generation and one raw audit. Root delegated that adoption to the input author; no separate independent reader reviewed the plan before generation. The writer imports only the SHA-pinned independent native/transition/System Python serializers. It never invokes their main functions, imports a product module, runs Rust, or reads actual product output. Existing corpora remain unchanged.

The generated manifest is `049f4416ceaab3ccb18581f49808aa0d5d526664ad5ef90ca386a62ec8e0199c`: 16 operation rows, three canonical checkpoints, and 106 unique blobs totaling 2,584,076 bytes. The independent stdlib parser audited the full raw inventory and hashes, the exact LSN/operation/epoch/WAL offset schedule, frame lengths, semantic owner/descriptors/native/redo identities, current Status/Undo/Catalog actors, Root/Jobs/credit equations, row continuity, allocator page identities, checkpoint scalars, the native N01 prefix, every native N02 row state, and the transition R01..R11 suffix. Generation took 0.020440 seconds and audit 0.007571 seconds, within the separate 30-second limits; both stderr files are empty.

MF14 is the first logical CREATE of T with the transition ROLLBACK order. The plan adds `outcome: aborted` beside `q: 0`, as transition R and native N02 do; outcome sets the AbortEnd Terminal Job outcome byte, while q changes no rollback byte. The actor stays epoch1/local1/generation2 throughout. Epoch1 holds durable L1..9 and ends with RollbackStart9 at WAL file offset 442,862. The live CLR10 was staged only in the in-memory WAL slot and unwound after the first retirement page install. The corpus therefore has no epoch1 CLR row, frame or partially installed page. The fresh runtime selects capture9 and writes CLR10, AbortEnd11, ReleaseRole12..14, RootFree15 and TerminalFinish16 with outer epoch2. Its WAL offsets restart at 4096, as in memory-gap MC03/MC04. Recovery CLR10 chains to the RollbackStart9 Tx descriptor (outer and header previous Tx LSN9).

L6..9 frames are byte-identical to transition R01..R04. L10..16 match R05..R11 except the outer writer epoch and its two envelope seals. Against native N02, L1..8 and L10 frames are identical, and L9 and L11..16 differ only in the outer epoch and its seals. All page, Jobs and descriptor states are identical. Checkpoint5 equals memory-gap MC04 checkpoint5, and checkpoints9 and 16 equal N02. The declared final scalars were derived from the operation list before generation and asserted by the generator. They match the N02 declaration: revision 12, issued/completed 2/2, cursor 1, C=Q=0, Aging groups 11 and consumed 296,896. Before generation, the author also inspected the frozen native/transition manifests read-only to choose these comparisons.

`steps.tsv` has the same 21-column shape as the original native corpus. `manifest.json` has `rows` and `checkpoints`, indexed by scenario and absolute LSN. `raw-index.tsv` is an exact bounded SHA/length/path inventory. `checkpoints.tsv` is a 10-column projection of the frozen manifest checkpoints, keyed by scenario and LSN, in the same format as memory-gap. It is bound by `checkpoint-projection-receipt.json` and was made without regeneration. The original consumer can read these immutable expectations, but must never install them into a live pool or home as a source of grants. Free/Reserved canonical arena images are zero; physical stale home bytes are not claimed zero. The fenced live pool image, the retained retirement marker, actual selected-base provenance and fresh recovery remain runtime obligations.

This is input preparation, not compiler, product, memory, or native execution evidence. All original limits remain unchanged. The receipt binds the writer, auditor, plan, manifest, raw index, steps, checkpoint projection, stdout and stderr.
